_note: TEMPLATE for tools/wfa_stats.py report. Copy it into your own output folder
and fix every relative path (paths resolve against THIS file's directory).
It exits 2 until the files it names exist - that is the tool refusing to
invent measurements, which is the correct behaviour.
selection      : what plateau chose (or paste the whole plateau JSON output;
trials         : EVERY variant tried across the whole development, not just
this grid. Undercounting it is the easiest way to fake a pass.
trial_sharpe_sd: the DISPERSION of trial Sharpes. Without it the hurdle is 0
and nothing is deflated, so the DSR gate FAILS by design.
Prefer listing the grid's own Sharpe values instead.
windows        : fill is_net_profit / oos_net_profit from each OOS report, and
params from selection_applied.json. Keep params identical to
benchmarks     : a directory of random-entry runs with the SAME exits, sizing
and trade count, 200+ of them. Do not use different exits.
cost_stress    : extra cost per trade in account currency (1.5-2x your average).
holdout_trades : optional, and it may be used exactly once.
